يحتسبون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَسِبُونَ (yaḥtasibūna) /jaħ.ta.si.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# يُحْتَسَبُونَ (yuḥtasabūna) /juħ.ta.sa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
